It first runs DrawableResourceCleanup on the head at dword_5EA5E8, then walks each of the three lists (heads dword_5EA608, dword_5EA5F8, dword_5EA5E8) freeing valid (byte +8 non-zero) payloads with type-specific destructors followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zeroes every list head/tail/counter global. No arguments and no return value contract beyond the last free-wrapper result.
